title: Scenario F - dependency-graph node shock
description: Shock one graph node. Ethena/backing/custodian nodes: USDe backing loss; asset:sUSDe: rate cut; stablecoin: debt-side depeg; protocol/market/PT: protocol failure (borrowers lose at most net equity).

node_id.description: Node of the dependency graph, e.g. offchain:ethena_backing, protocol:pendle, asset:USDC.

loss_pct.description: Fraction of value lost at the node, e.g. 0.10.

oracle_pass_through_override.description: null = use each market's oracle_pass_through from the snapshot.
